purpose: Bounded test of Cloudflare Queues as an alternative to a Node verifier, without changing any account tariff

limitConfiguration.message: CPU limits are not supported for the Free plan. Switch to a paid plan to set CPU limits.

decision: Do not use this queue as the production verifier; retain tested Node adapter pending provider/workspace choice. No billing plan changed. Remove only the probe queue, worker and private probe table; preserve ranking API and database.
